title: Sensitive Systems Take Note
caption: Restlessness could have a louder background today. Pace yourself with short slow breathing breaks and gentle movement between tasks.
snapshot: Geomagnetics are active and orienting southward. Recent space activity includes one flare and one CME, while background field oscillations are a bit livelier than usual. Overall the environment is unsettled for sensitive systems.
affects: Energy may swing between wired alertness and sudden fatigue. Small tasks might feel disproportionately intense for stretches. Some people notice more tension or an urge to move, followed by a deep slump.
playbook:
- Use 3–5 minute slow-breath breaks when you feel wired
- Favor short, gentle movement breaks rather than long intense exercise
- Keep snacks simple and hydrating to avoid sugar spikes
- Pace big tasks and tuck in extra rest windows

fb.caption: Can't sleep even when your body is begging for it? Your evening may feel a bit jumpy tonight. There's active space weather in the mix with a recent flare and a CME on the books, and the planet's background hum is a touch livelier than usual. That can translate to more wakeful moments and a bedtime that needs extra kindness. Try shortening bright screens and simplifying the last hour before sleep so your nervous system has fewer signals to track. If you wake and can't drop back in, a few slow breaths and a soft stretch can help reset without forcing sleep. Gaia Eyes is watching the patterns so you can tune the pace when nights feel thin.
